scope: All 135 authored openmind.lesson/1.0 lessons. Implemented means a code path exists; integrated means at least one authored lesson uses it; server-marked means /api/progress grades and records it; browser-verified means a real browser exercised the visible control. These are separate claims.

browserRun.note: Browser-measured authored lesson pages and plan figures. The authoredCatalogue value is checked against audit/lesson-catalogue.json; a mismatch is a stale record, not a pass.

formatsBrowserRun.note: Browser-driven submissions, not render-only. The evidence ledger is read back after submission.

codeBrowserRun.note: Every authored code item had its own editor, sandbox and runner exercised. lists-arrays additionally had a real edit, reset and repaired pass. A passed stdout check is practice feedback, not a recorded mark.

browserVerified.detail: the authored-contract loop paints the item; no submission is made
the authored-contract loop paints the item; the one unscored reflection is labelled
scatter: 2/4 then 4/4; electricity: three method + three answer marks reach 6/6 in the browser

formats.label: Structured response — graph, plot, read-off, table

browserVerified.detail: implemented in the assessment app, refused by lib/lesson-verify.ts for authored lessons

formats.label: Gap fill — one independently marked blank per gap

union selection, keyboard toggle and 20% = 1/5 input are submitted visibly
probability-basics and tree-diagrams completed visibly, invalid input refused
coin, die and bag runs, reset, and exhaustive outcome counts
